# skycloak_cluster_build (Data Source)

A single cluster image build, including its log lines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_build" "latest" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  build_id   = data.skycloak_cluster_builds.production.builds[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) Build ID.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String) Completion time (RFC 3339).
- `error` (String) Failure detail, when failed.
- `logs` (List of String) Build log lines.
- `phase` (String) Current phase.
- `progress` (Number) Percentage complete.
- `started_at` (String) Start time (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String) Build status.
